description: This Python source file defines a service class for handling file uploads to storage backends, creating file objects with storage metadata, generating unified file IDs, and managing storage in a system for files related to OpenAI integrations. It includes methods for uploading files, creating file objects, and storing files in a managed system with unique IDs.

classes.name: StorageBackendFileService
classes.description: A service class providing static methods for uploading files to storage backends, creating file objects with metadata, generating unified IDs, and storing files in a managed system.

methods.name: upload_file_to_storage_backend
methods.description: Uploads a file to a specified storage backend, creates a file object with storage metadata, and optionally stores it in a managed files system.

methods.name: _create_file_object_with_storage_metadata
methods.description: Creates an OpenAIFileObject with metadata about the storage backend and URL.

methods.name: _create_unified_file_id
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded unified file ID for managed files, incorporating file type, a UUID, target model names, and the original file ID.

methods.name: _store_in_managed_files
methods.description: Stores the file in a managed files system with a unified ID, updating the file object and creating model mappings.
